I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The date for the CRM is 2025-11-03. Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 2025-11-02 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03."

That digest is the only source I found. It doesn't name Kwame as the new owner, and I couldn't see a contract or CRM record to confirm the date. I suggested he check it against the account's own paperwork if the CRM needs an official record.

I also warned him that "PHL" is shared with Covey & Lark Retail, now Pellow Home Living, so he should make sure he's on the port-logistics account.
